checks.name: FIRST_FUN
checks.evidence: Seed 31, one real desktop click: launch at 0.13 s wall time, visible first cut at 0.97 s, then sharp anchor on white-landing at 2.61 s. opening-cut.png and anchor.png preserve the visible transitions. A separate native-touch run cut once and anchored in 1.48 s.

checks.name: CONTACTS
checks.evidence: Real input visibly produced sharp anchoring and a later blunt bounce/recovery; anchor.png and bounce.png show distinct feedback, and a follow-up real click relaunched. However, independent play did not reproduce both outcomes as two simple opening timing branches; the bounce occurred later near the pillar/hazard section.

checks.name: DECISION
checks.evidence: Visible-state real-input timing changed outcomes: the wait-until-descending policy reached the safe gate, while a fixed 1.1 s cadence reached a magenta spike. Early rapid inputs also sent the blade above the playfield and failed by fall, so repeated inputs do not collapse to one trajectory.

checks.name: FAILURES
checks.evidence: Real input produced distinct fall and spike reasons with visibly different presentations: desktop-natural-04.png shows the abyss result and spike.png shows the magenta break result. One real terminal native touch reset spike failure to ready with failReason cleared.

checks.name: SAFE_FINISH
checks.evidence: A visible-position policy using only real mouse clicks reached finishSelection=safe at 17.36 s wall time without debug placement. safe-finish.png shows the safe-gate result.

checks.name: BONUS
checks.evidence: The narrow bonus entry is visible, but two intentional real-input finish timing changes still selected the safe gate at y=396 and y=357. The independent reviewer did not enter, play, or verify one-chance behavior in reasonable time; no bonus screenshot is claimed.

checks.name: MOBILE
checks.evidence: At 390x844, one native touch produced cut then white-landing anchor in 1.48 s; a separate native-touch 1.1 s cadence reached spike failure, and one native touch restarted to ready. scrollWidth/innerWidth=390 and scrollHeight/innerHeight=844, so no overflow was present. mobile-anchor.png and mobile.png preserve evidence.

checks.name: RUNTIME
checks.evidence: No page exception or game console error occurred. However, after a real launch, a 1.394 s low-frame/main-thread pause advanced simulation by only 0.10 s (elapsed 0.05 to 0.15; x 127.5 to 142.5), silently discarding about 1.29 s of real time. Six concurrent throttled pages independently showed the same class of elapsed-time loss.

issues.message: Anchor and blunt bounce are not both independently reachable as simple opening timing branches.
issues.evidence: The reviewer reached the first sharp anchor immediately, but blunt bounce appeared only later near the pillar/hazard section.

issues.message: The narrow bonus route was not independently reachable with a small finish timing change.
issues.evidence: Two real-input variants landed in the safe gate; bonus entry and one-chance bonus play were not verified.

issues.message: Low-frame real time is silently discarded during active play.
issues.evidence: A 1.394 s real main-thread pause advanced active simulation by only 0.10 s. See console.log.
